order_delivery.safety_tier_description: Standard fulfillment and shipping inquiries eligible for automated resolution if confidence exceeds calibrated threshold.

tracking_status_eta.split_rationale: High-volume inquiry regarding package transit, delivery window, or carrier delay. Grounds on standardized carrier tracking deep-links and expected delivery SLA communication.

damaged_or_missing_items.split_rationale: Requires packaging verification, carrier claim intake, or replacement dispatch. Differs fundamentally from tracking by initiating claims workflow rather than tracking lookup.

wrong_item_delivered.split_rationale: Requires return-and-replace authorization and inventory verification. Cannot use generic tracking reply; must provide return label guidance.

payments_refunds.safety_tier_description: Transaction and refund status issues. Automatable for standard policy inquiries (SLA timelines), but escalates if payment disputes or unauthorized charges are present.

refund_status_delay.split_rationale: Inquiries on standard 3-5 business day banking windows vs processed credit note. Grounds on standard refund timeline policies.

double_billing_payment_failed.split_rationale: Involves payment gateway retry logic, pending authorization holds vs settled charges. Distinct from processed refunds.

unauthorized_charge.split_rationale: Financial security concern; involves potential card theft. Requires human escalation for fraud inspection.

account_access.safety_tier_description: HARD OVERRIDE: Any account security, compromised credentials, or OTP lockout must unconditionally route to human specialists.

compromised_account_hijack.split_rationale: High-risk identity compromise. Customer may have active unauthorized orders placed by bad actor. Hard-overridden to human security team.

mfa_password_lockout.split_rationale: Access credential lockout or two-step verification device change. Hard-overridden to protect PII and prevent social engineering.

product_digital.safety_tier_description: Digital subscription (Prime), Kindle, or digital media access issues.

prime_membership_billing.split_rationale: Inquiries regarding annual/monthly renewal, benefits, or accidental renewal cancellation within grace period.

digital_content_kindle_video.split_rationale: Troubleshooting digital entitlement, Kindle library sync, or Prime Video playback errors.

abuse_safety.safety_tier_description: HARD OVERRIDE: Phishing, scams, brand impersonation, harassment, or legal threats unconditionally route to human trust/safety teams.

phishing_scam_report.split_rationale: Customer reporting suspicious SMS/calls claiming to be Amazon. Requires immediate reporting intake and security advisory.

harassment_threatening_conduct.split_rationale: Legal threats, profanity, or aggressive disputes that pose legal or PR liability. Must never receive an automated chatbot reply.
